name: KT
message: Coming from someone who has Just successfully completed 1 year of Experience in this field 🤭 I must say, it’s geniunely a Beautiful feeling to have a Companion to share your life with , your partner is like the Witness to your life, all the sunrise and sunsets, moon gazing , coffees , hugs and kisses become a part of your daily routine. YES, daily Routine! Can you imagine? Am so glad you both found your forever in each other , wedding and specially the wedding planning & the post wedding life - it’s the Best Thing, really! My only 2 cents are going to be - Before Everything else, always be each other’s BEST FRIEND! ♥️ Loads of Love to you both! 💕
